title: Cellana vote_manager::rescue_stuck_rewards — no-signer reward recycling
closed_reasons: rescue_stuck_rewards claims rewards for the passed address and sends every FungibleAsset to incentivize(pool, rescued), which deposits into the pool's incentive reward pool; there is no transfer/mint/deposit to the caller
rewards_pool::claim_rewards, add_rewards, increase_allocation and decrease_allocation are friend-only, with vote_manager as the sole friend; no external allocation-mint or direct-claim path exists
live veNFTs are excluded by assert!(!voting_escrow::nft_exists(account_address)); a fresh address has no veNFT and zero claimable rewards
the protocol is dust: top pool 0 USDC + 13 APT; prior-epoch fee total 0; incentive pool empty
principal (LP, staked, veNFT locked) is never in scope; only reward shares move
key_facts: Deployed entry: rescue_stuck_rewards(address, vector<Object<LiquidityPool>>, u64), no &signer
Source mirror and deployed ABI agree; the only asset sink is incentivize -> rewards_pool::add_rewards(incentive_pool, rewards, epoch+1)
Top pool 0x234f0be5… holds 0 USDC / 13 APT and carries 86.5% of votes
total_rewards(fees_pool, 2965) = 0; total_rewards(incentive_pool, 2965) = 0; epoch 2966 fees = 44.65 USDC + 73.79 APT (~$87.9)
A fresh address has nft_exists=false, claimable_rewards=[0,0] for the prior epoch
Entry simulation blocked by the APT gas balance check; dead-veNFT inventory not enumerable (indexer events deprecated; 408/429 on heavy queries)
caveats: Source is a third-party mirror (asilenced/Boston_Next.js@ae6b912) but is ABI-identical to the deployed module
Dead-veNFT reward inventory is unmeasured; this bounds only the indirect LP-share number, not the direct-payout verdict
No Move decompiler was provisioned; evidence is ABI + source + live /v1/view
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 directly from Cellana rescue_stuck_rewards: it only recycles the passed address's reward shares into the pool's incentive pool, never pays the caller, and the live protocol is dust.
